PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

This is not AI. Brilliantly captured by Chandrasekar Das, this stunning leopard resting somewhere in Nilgiris, reminds me about an interesting fact that often goes unnoticed. While most people know India counts its tigers every four years through the All India Tiger Estimation (AITE), not many know that the same nationwide survey by @ntca_india also produces one of the world’s most rigorous leopard population estimates. Individual leopards are identified by their unique rosette patterns, just as tigers are recognised by their stripe patterns, The latest Status of Leopards in India, 2022 estimated 13,874 leopards (95% CI: 12,616–15,132) across India’s tiger-bearing landscapes, which encompass nearly 70% of the country’s leopard habitat. Every tiger photographed, therefore, also tells the story of leopards, prey, habitats and the health of an entire forest ecosystem. Amazing 😊 #leopards #wildlife #TNForest

This is one of the most beloved paintings in America, and it puts its finger on something we all pass through, first as the child, and one day as the parent left behind... The painting is Breaking Home Ties, by Norman Rockwell, on the cover of the Saturday Evening Post in 1954. A father and his teenage son sit side by side on the running board of a battered farm truck, waiting at a railway stop. A single track runs along the bottom of the picture. A ticket pokes from the boy's pocket. His suitcase is stacked with schoolbooks and wears a "State U" pennant. The train is coming to carry him off to college, away from home, for the first time in his life. Everything is in the way they sit. The son sits upright, scrubbed and dressed in his best, eyes fixed on the horizon, on the track, on the future rushing toward him. He is already half gone. For him that train is the beginning of everything. His father sits beside him in worn work clothes and scuffed boots, looking the other way, down the line, as if he cannot bear to watch it arrive. The same train means the opposite thing to him. For the son it is the start of a life. For the father it is the day the house grows quieter, the chair at the table sits empty, and the person he built his world around walks out into a life that no longer has him at its centre. Look at his hands. He is holding two hats. His own battered one, and resting on top of it, his son's crisp new one, held carefully together, because it is the last small thing he can still do for the boy... And then the dog, its head laid in the son's lap, gazing up, refusing to look away. Rockwell knew exactly what that was for: "The father couldn't show how he felt about the boy's leaving," he said. "The dog did." It has moved people for 70 years because every leaving is a beginning for one person and an ending for another. The child steps out into the world, as they should. And someone stays behind, watching them go, and loving them enough to let them go anyway...

राष्ट्रसेवा आणि राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षेतील अतुलनीय योगदानाचा सन्मान! केंद्रीय गृह व सहकार मंत्री अमित शाह यांच्या हस्ते आणि मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत भारताचे राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सल्लागार अजित डोवाल यांना 'लोकमान्य टिळक राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार 2026' प्रदान करण्यात आला. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यावेळी म्हणाले, आज सर्वांकरिता अतिशय आनंदाचा दिवस आहे. देशातील अनेक मान्यवरांचा लोकमान्य टिळक राष्ट्रीय पुरस्काराने गौरव करण्यात आला आहे. यंदा हा पुरस्कार राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षेला नवी दिशा देणाऱ्या आणि त्यासाठी आपले जीवन समर्पित करणाऱ्या अजित डोवाल यांना प्रदान करण्यात आला आहे. राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षेच्या क्षेत्रात ज्यांना 'चाणक्य' म्हणून ओळखले जाते, त्या अजित डोवाल यांना हा पुरस्कार प्रदान करण्यासाठी राजकीय क्षेत्रातील 'चाणक्य' येथे उपस्थित आहेत. अजित डोवाल यांनी प्रथम पोलीस सेवेत, त्यानंतर इंटेलिजन्स ब्युरो (आयबी) आणि रिसर्च अँड ॲनालिसिस विंगच्या (R&AW) माध्यमातून देशासाठी अत्यंत महत्त्वपूर्ण कार्य केले. विशेषतः 2014 मध्ये पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी अजित डोवाल यांची राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सल्लागार म्हणून नियुक्ती केल्यानंतर त्यांनी देशाच्या सुरक्षा व्यवस्थेत आमूलाग्र बदल घडवून आणण्याचे काम केले. अजित डोवाल यांनी राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षेसाठी आखलेल्या रणनीतीमुळे भारत आता शत्रूच्या भूमीत घुसून प्रत्युत्तर देणारा देश बनला आहे. अजित डोवाल यांनी अनेकदा स्वतःचा जीव धोक्यात घालून देशासाठी कार्य केले, मात्र त्यासाठी कधीही कोणत्याही पुरस्काराची अपेक्षा ठेवली नाही. अशा व्यक्तिमत्त्वाला लोकमान्य टिळक राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार प्रदान होत असल्याचा अत्यंत आनंद आहे, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, भारतात राष्ट्रवादाची मुहूर्तमेढ रोवण्याचे कार्य समाजसुधारक आणि थोर क्रांतिकारक लोकमान्य बाळ गंगाधर टिळक यांनी केले. त्यामुळे त्यांना भारतीय राष्ट्रवादाचे जनक म्हटले जाते. भारत ब्रिटिशांच्या गुलामीत असताना लोकमान्य टिळक यांनी भारतीयांची मानसिकता बदलून त्यांच्या मनामध्ये देशभक्तीची भावना जागवली. आपला समाज धार्मिक व आध्यात्मिक असल्याने समाजाला एकत्र आणण्यासाठी त्यांनी सार्वजनिक गणेशोत्सवाची सुरुवात केली. बहुजन समाजाला एकत्रित करून स्वातंत्र्यलढ्याला व्यापक लोकचळवळीचे स्वरूप दिले. तसेच सार्वजनिक शिवजयंती उत्सवाच्या माध्यमातून तरुणांना राष्ट्रभक्ती आणि स्वाभिमानाची प्रेरणा दिली. अशाच समर्पणाने आणि देशभक्तीच्या भावनेने आयुष्यभर राष्ट्रसेवा करणाऱ्या अजित डोवाल यांना हा पुरस्कार प्रदान करण्यात येत असल्याचा आनंद आहे. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, केंद्रीय राज्यमंत्री मुरलीधर मोहोळ, मंत्री चंद्रकांत पाटील, मंत्री उदय सामंत, राज्यमंत्री माधुरी मिसाळ, आमदार रविंद्र चव्हाण, लोकमान्य टिळक स्मारक ट्रस्टचे अध्यक्ष डॉ. रोहित टिळक व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi Today we celebrate George de Hevesy’s birthday! He was a radiochemist who helped develop radioactive tracers. Born in 1885, de Hevesy first stumbled on radiotracers while trying to perform another experiment (that proved to be impossible) involving radium-D, or lead-210. A radiotracer is made by replacing one or more atoms of a chemical compound with a radioactive isotope of the same chemical element. Then by using a sensitive radiation detection device, scientists can track the small amount of radiation released from the radioactive isotope. In this case, de Hevesy figured out he could introduce a small sample of lead-212, a radioactive isotope of lead, into the roots of a plant and then by monitoring how it moved through a plant, he could understand the plant’s metabolic processes. This work on radiotracers earned de Hevesy the 1943 @NobelPrize for Chemistry. Radiotracers are still an effective tool used today in a range of areas, from medicine to industry to environmental science.

What kinds of investment enable small-scale producers to move into higher-value markets, stronger processing capacity and better returns from their production? In Nepal, the US$18.9 million High Value Agriculture Project in Hill and Mountain Areas (HVAP) – co-financed by IFAD, the Government of Nepal, the SNV Netherlands Development Organization and other partners – offers a strong example. The project supported small-scale producers with improved processing methods, technical assistance and stronger market linkages, helping create the conditions for more reliable buyers and private-sector engagement. A Nepali-Dutch joint venture, the Organic Valley, expanded a local processing plant and by 2026 was sourcing ginger from more than 1,400 farmers and exporting 347 metric tons to Europe. Over time, production increased from 300 metric tonnes to 2,400, farmers’ incomes rose by 37%, and crop earnings increased by 50%. As HVAP shows, sustainable rural economic growth is driven not only by increased production, but by the private sector linkages that connect producers to global markets across strong value chains. از دوران مجاهدان و دور قبلی طالبان که بگذریم، این روزها شاید تاریک‌ترین روزهایی باشد که پوهنتون کابل با آن روبه‌رو است. پوهنتون کابل در سال ۱۳۱۱ خورشیدی تأسیس شد. در آغاز، فقط دانشکده‌ی طب در آن بود. بعدها، پس از تشکیل دانشکده‌های حقوق، ساینس و ادبیات، رسما به نام پوهنتون کابل مسمی شد. این پوهنتون که نزدیک به یک قرن از زمان تأسیس آن می‌گذرد، شاگردان زیادی از آن فارغ شده‌اند. افرادی همچون داکتر محمد یوسف، سلطان‌علی کشتمند، اناهیتا راتب‌زاد، طاهر بدخشی، سیما سمر، عبدالغفور روان‌ فرهادی، حمیده برمکی، اکرم یاری، واصف باختری... شاگردان نامدار این پوهنتون بودند. اما امروزه، پوهنتون کابل در وضعی است که سزاوارش نیست. امروز، نه ما شاگردان خیلی زبده هستیم و نه پوهنتون کابل آن پوهنتونی است که بود و یا باید باشد. شواهد تاریخی نشان می‌دهد که پوهنتون کابل اکثرا مکانی برای مبارزه با افراطیت، بی‌عدالتی، فساد، خرافات و... بوده است؛ اما امروز خبری از آن مبارزه‌ها نیست. در بیست سال جمهوریت کرزی و غنی، همچنان پوهنتون کابل جایگاه ویژه‌ی خود را داشت. شاگردان انقلابی داشت؛ شاگردانی که به تشدید خرافات «نه» می‌گفتند. در آن دوران، شاهد اعتراضاتی بودیم که در آن همواره از سران انتقاد می‌شد. شاهد تظاهرات برای مبارزه با فساد، بیکاری و غیره بودیم. در این ۲۰ سال نیز شاگردان خیلی به‌دردبخوری از این پوهنتون فارغ شدند. برعکس روزهایی که در پوهنتون کابل با افراطیت مبارزه می‌شد، امروز همان افراطیت در آن حاکم شده است. ملاها هر قسم که دل‌شان شود، فرمان می‌دهند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258326

For China’s wealth owners, four measures matter most: • The Supervision Law (2018; revised 2024) — transformed the risk to personal liberty. • The Counter-Espionage Law (2023) — vastly expanded the boundaries of “national security.” • The new offshore trust tax rules (July 2026) — fundamentally changed the calculation of wealth protection. • The new Exit-Entry Regulations (August 2026) — strengthened the state’s control over mobility and the ability to leave. For decades, the typical Chinese tycoon believed he could continue living in China, keep his business and political relationships there, leave part of his family there, but place his shares, cash and investments in Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, BVI or an offshore trust, obtain foreign residency or even a second passport, and thereby continue enjoying China’s economic upside while placing his core wealth beyond the Party’s reach. That assumption has collapsed. Almost every entrepreneur I have known over the past three decades underestimated the ruthlessness of the CCP. Ironically, those who understood the risks best were often the red aristocrats. They had witnessed the Party’s campaigns, purges and expropriations from the inside. Many private entrepreneurs, by contrast, had studied too little of modern Chinese history. One phrase I heard many times was: “All my wealth came from China. If one day the government wants it back, I am happy to give it back.” This was not merely public relations language used by people such as Jack Ma of Alibaba or Richard Liu of JD. Entrepreneurs often said it directly to my face when I urged them to diversify their wealth outside China. I suspect many never truly believed that day might actually come. For most wealth owners, it is probably too late now. If the individual remains in China, the state holds the decisive leverage: exit bans, investigation, summons, detention, tax enforcement, and pressure applied through trustees, banks or family members. An offshore trust may protect assets in an ordinary civil dispute. It cannot reliably protect a settlor who remains physically inside an authoritarian state. If the wealth still originates from Chinese companies, dividends, red-chip structures, property sales or family transfers, the authorities can pursue it through tax residency, foreign exchange rules, beneficial ownership and source-of-funds investigations. A foreign passport, by itself, does not end Chinese tax exposure. What matters is where you actually live, where your family is, where your economic interests remain, and whether China still regards you as a tax resident. If your spouse, children, parents, beneficiaries or family business remain in China, the state still retains substantial leverage. I am convinced Beijing thought carefully about the sequence before introducing these measures. The offshore trust rules and the new Exit-Entry Regulations were not introduced because the leadership feared wealthy Chinese might start running. They were introduced because Beijing believes the window for most of them to escape has already closed. For decades, many Chinese entrepreneurs misunderstood the true nature of the CCP. The boom years convinced them that the Party itself may have fundamentally changed—that the political risks of the Mao era belonged to history. At the same time, the extraordinary opportunities created by China’s economic boom made the upside of staying fully invested in China seem far greater than the cost of preparing for a much darker future. Xi Jinping did not fundamentally change the nature of the CCP. He just reminded China’s entrepreneurs what it had always been capable of. For many, the risks they dismissed have become reality. Perhaps foreign investors should pay close attention to the lesson being taught—at the expense of China’s entrepreneurs.

This is the conventional wisdom: Microsoft should make security features free or include them in lower-tier plans. Unfortunately, in this specific example from @HackingLZ, moving risk-based Conditional Access to P1 is unlikely to make a significant dent in global security risk. Why? I spent the better part of three years trying to persuade organizations that already had E5 licenses to enable P2 features. Sadly, very few did. Even though they were already paying for them. Deployment simply required too much work and change management on their end. My entire team at Microsoft worked with E5 customers, and one of the things we actively tracked and followed up on was the deployment of risk-based Conditional Access policies. Microsoft even offered incentives to account teams worldwide when the customers they managed enabled risk-based Conditional Access. Yet there were still very few takers. So, taking a step back: what can Microsoft do to have the greatest impact on the security of all its customers? My observation was that the biggest improvements came from security features that required customers to do nothing. The “Microsoft-managed” class of features is what actually moves the needle on security. Some key initiatives included: → Blocking legacy authentication protocols for Exchange Online → Enforcing MFA for Azure (you wouldn’t believe how many enterprises. Even regulated ones, threw the book at us over this) → Introducing Microsoft-managed Conditional Access policies → Blocking device code flow by default The next major effort is disabling SMS and voice-based MFA while rolling out passkeys. That change alone will improve security for an enormous number of organizations. These initiatives require a huge amount of time, effort, and follow-up to help customers manage the impact. Many of the ones listed above were multi-year projects, with some taking three+ years to move the final group of customers across. In my opinion, it can sometimes be better for more advanced features to remain paid. Customers recognize them as premium capabilities, pay for them, and 'ideally' commit the resources needed to deploy them properly. Featured speakers included Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao (pictured below), Vice Chief of Naval Operations Adm. James Kilby, Assistant Secretary of War (Science and Technology) Dr. Joseph Jewell, futurist Dr. Peter Singer and Chief of Naval Research Dr. Rachel Riley. They were joined by Sailors and Marines, researchers, industry, academia and innovators whose partnerships continue to advance naval science and technology. Through keynote remarks and technology exhibits, the event underscored a fundamental truth: maintaining our technological edge requires investing in ideas long before they become operational capabilities. As outlined in ONR's newly released Science & Technology Strategy, the DoN’s most consequential challenges demand research that is transformational, uniquely Naval and often too early or specialized for others to attempt. ONR exists to discover, develop and deliver the S&T that underpins those capabilities, ensuring the Fleet and Force remain ready to meet tomorrow's challenges. “For eight decades, ONR has stood at the vanguard of naval power,” Cao said. “You’re the operational engine that transforms science fiction into tactical reality on the high seas.” Since 1946, ONR has brought together the people and partnerships needed to pursue the scientific research and technological development required to sustain America's maritime dominance. Zimbabwe destroyed itself the day it destroyed the people who produce. Confiscating 4,500 productive commercial farms from the people who actually knew how to run them and handing them to political allies with zero farming experience is precisely how you turn Africa’s breadbasket into a country that can’t feed itself and ends up printing 100 trillion dollar notes that won’t even cover a bus fare. Mugabe did exactly that in 2000. >commercial farmland lost 3/4 of its value in a single year >food production dropped 60% over the next decade >nearly 700 companies that depended on farm exports and food processing shut down within 2 years >the economy shrank more than 6% a year and average incomes fell by more than half “Just give poor people money, bro!” And so they did with the tax base gone! >printed money to fill the hole >prices were doubling every 24 hours by late 2008 >official inflation numbers stopped being published and an independent economist calculated monthly inflation at 79.6 billion %. Communism is grand. Video Rothmus 🏴 (@Rothmus) Germany printed money until people burned banknotes for heat because firewood cost more. By late 1923, workers got paid TWICE A DAY because their wages lost value between breakfast and lunch. The spiral started when France and Belgium occupied the Ruhr after Germany missed reparations payments, German workers walked out in mass strike, and the government covered their wages by running the printing presses nonstop. $1 bought 4.2 marks in 1914 and 4.2 trillion by November 1923. People hauled pay home in wheelbarrows and suitcases while wives met husbands at the factory gate to spend the morning’s money before afternoon prices made it worthless. Gustav Stresemann introduced the Rentenmark in November, backed by mortgages on land and industry after the gold was gone, and simply cut 12 zeros off the old prices. It stabilized almost overnight. A year later the Reichsmark replaced it and the hyperinflation that erased an entire middle class’s savings was over within weeks. Fertility fell to 1.28. • England and Wales: Births fell 1.6% in 2025, while fertility dropped to an estimated 1.39. • Scotland: Births reached their lowest level since records began in 1855. Fertility hit a record-low 1.25. • Austria: Births fell to a 25-year low. Fertility hit a record-low 1.30. • Switzerland: Fertility fell again to 1.28 in 2025. • Greece: 68,467 births vs 126,916 deaths. • Malta, Spain and Lithuania recorded the EU’s lowest fertility rates: 1.01, 1.10 and 1.11. • Spain still recorded 122,167 more deaths than births in 2025, despite a small rise in births. • Finland: Fertility rose slightly to 1.30 in 2025, but remains far below 1.87 in 2010. Replacement level is roughly 2.1 children per woman. Europe’s demographic crisis is no longer limited to just a few countries. A dear friend of mine handed me this writing found from a nursing home resident and I want to share it with you... “I am 82 years old, I have 4 children, 11 grandchildren, 2 great-grandchildren and a room of 12 square meters. I no longer have a home or expensive things, but I have someone who will clean my room, prepare food and change my bedding, measure my blood pressure and weigh me. I no longer have the laughter of my grandchildren around me, I don't see them growing, hugging and arguing. Some come to me every 15 days, some every three or four months, and some never. I don't bake cakes anymore, I don't dig up the garden. I still have hobbies and I like to read, but my eyes quickly hurt. I don’t know how much longer, but I have to get used to this loneliness. Here at this home, I lead group work and help those who are worse than me as much as I can. Until recently, I read aloud to an immobile woman in the room next to me, we used to sing together, but she died the other day. They say life is getting longer. Why? When I’m alone, I can look at photos of my family and memories I brought from home. And that's all. I miss them. I hope that the next generations will understand that families are born to have a future (with children) and that they do not forget about the family even in old age.” PLEASE DON'T FORGET YOUR LOVED ONES.

How can food systems create economic opportunity? Food is essential to nutrition, health and well-being. For millions of rural people, it is also a source of livelihood. When agricultural production is effectively marketed, processed and traded, it can generate income, create jobs and drive broader rural transformation. In Cambodia, IFAD’s ASPIRE programme has supported this transition. One example is Kampot pepper – a geographical indication product now reaching international markets, including Germany, where its recognized value has opened new opportunities for small-scale producers. Between 2014 and 2022, ASPIRE reached more than 143,000 households, helping farmers move from informal local trading to more structured commercial relationships. IFAD impact assessments show that participating farmers increased market sales volumes by 41% on average and incomes by more than 50%. By strengthening productivity and market linkages, the programme helped build a value chain connecting Cambodian small-scale producers to both domestic and export markets. Since 2017, IFAD-supported cooperatives have supplied Kampot pepper to Germany’s Fuchs Group, Europe’s largest spice manufacturer – enabling farmers to secure more competitive prices, reduce uncertainty and plan production more effectively. The statement said Hamkar requested Uzbekistan's cooperation in equipment calibration, laboratory standardization, and the establishment of mobile laboratories to help identify and resolve technical problems in Afghanistan's power network more efficiently. The Uzbek side expressed its readiness to cooperate in enhancing the capacity of technical staff, equipment calibration, specialized training programs, and the provision of mobile laboratories. وزارت داخله‌ی اسپانیا اعلام کرده است که از روز پنج‌شنبه تا کنون حدود ‌۵۰ هزار مهاجر از طریق زمین و دریا وارد سئوتا، منطقه‌ی تحت حاکمیت اسپانیا در شمال آفریقا، شده‌اند. سئوتا منطقه‌ای کوچک در ساحل شمالی آفریقا و در محاصره‌ی خاک ‌مراکش است. به گزارش خبرگزاری رویترز، وزارت داخله‌ی اسپانیا گفته است که حدود ۲۵ هزار نفر از مهاجران به‌صورت داوطلبانه به مراکش بازگشته‌اند. خوان خسوس ویواس، رییس حکومت محلی سئوتا، شمار مهاجرانی را ‌که وارد این منطقه شده‌اند تا ۶۰ هزار نفر اعلام کرده و گفته است که ‌‌۳۴ نفر در جریان این رویداد جان باخته‌اند. مقام‌های اسپانیایی پیش‌تر ‌از پیدا شدن ۱۹ جسد در آب خبر داده بودند. ورود هزاران مهاجر پس از تغییر یک رویکرد اسپانیا در قبال ‌مهاجرت صورت می‌گیرد. آنخل ویکتور تورس، وزیر سیاست ارضی اسپانیا گفته است که از ‌جمله عوامل مؤثر در این افزایش، ممکن است حکم دیوان عالی اسپانیا ‌در اوایل این ماه باشد. دادگاه عالی اسپانیا حکم داده است: «مهاجرانی که از طریق دریا خود ‌را به سئوتا و ملیله برسانند، بدون تثبیت هویت و فرصت درخواست ‌پناهندگی، به‌صورت فوری اخراج نشوند.» هجوم گسترده‌ی مهاجران به مرز سئوتا واکنش و اختلاف‌نظرهایی را در ‌اروپا به‌دنبال داشته است. برخی رهبران کشورهای عضو اتحادیه ‌اروپا از اسپانیا خواسته‌اند برای مهار این بحران اقدام کند. احزاب راست‌گرای اروپایی نیز سیاست‌های مهاجرتی نسبتا آسان‌گیرانه‌ی ‌اسپانیا، از جمله اعطای عفو به صدها هزار مهاجر فاقد مجوز اقامت را از عوامل این بحران دانسته‌اند. فرانسه اعلام کرده است که کنترل‌های مرزی خود با اسپانیا را افزایش ‌می‌دهد و ایتالیا نیز تهدید کرده است که اسپانیا را از طرح مرزهای باز ‌داخلی اتحادیه اروپا کنار خواهد گذاشت.‌ پدرو سانچز، نخست‌وزیر اسپانیا هجوم مهاجران را «حمله» توصیف ‌کرد و گفته است که همه‌ی مهاجران غیرقانونی «در اسرع وقت» به ‌مراکش بازگردانده خواهند شد. It is with profound sorrow that we bid farewell to Jeanne Gibson, our beloved Rosie the Riveter, has passed away today, July 29, 2026, at the remarkable age of 100. With her passing, we don't simply mourn the loss of a beloved friend, we honor the life of an American hero whose courage, dedication, and unwavering spirit helped shape history, and will continue to inspire generations to come.📷📷 At just 18 years old, Jeanne left her home in Minnesota in the summer of 1944 and answered her nation's call, becoming a welder at Todd Pacific Shipyards in Seattle. With determination and grit, she helped build destroyers that strengthened the Allied war effort during World War II. She later continued her service with the Army Transportation Corps in Juneau, Alaska, embodying the resilience and patriotism of the Greatest Generation. Yet Jeanne's legacy extended far beyond the war. She earned her Ph.D., dedicated three decades to teaching, earned her private pilot license, and spent the rest of her life proving that courage, determination, and purpose know no age. In 2024, Jeanne and her fellow Rosies were collectively awarded the Congressional Gold Medal, one of our nation's highest civilian honors, recognizing the extraordinary women whose sacrifices and determination helped secure victory during World War II. To all of us at Pacific Historic Parks, Jeanne was far more than a Rosie, she was family. She traveled to Hawaiʻi time and again to share her remarkable story with visitors, inspire local students, and ensure that the sacrifices of the Home Front would never be forgotten. Her radiant smile, generous heart, and boundless enthusiasm touched every life she encountered. She had a special gift for encouraging young girls, reminding them that no dream was too big and no obstacle too great. Through her words and her example, she inspired generations to believe in themselves and pursue lives of courage, service, and purpose. Jeanne remained a tireless advocate for preserving the legacy of the Rosies, volunteering at Rosie the Riveter WWII Home Front National Historical Park on "Rosie Fridays" and ensuring the stories of the women who helped win the war would continue to inspire future generations. In one of life's poignant moments, just days before her passing, Jeanne was celebrated with a Wall of Honor banner at the park she loved so dearly and recognized during a San Jose Earthquakes halftime ceremony honoring Bay Area heroes. It was a fitting tribute to a woman whose life was defined by selfless service, quiet strength, and extraordinary grace. Though Jeanne has taken her final flight, her legacy will never fade. It lives on in every story she shared, every young person she inspired, every life she touched, and in the enduring example of courage she leaves behind. Our hearts are with Jeanne's family, her fellow Rosies, and all who were blessed to know and love her. Rest in peace, Jeanne Gibson. Thank you for answering the call when your country needed you most. Thank you for showing generations what courage looks like. We will remember you always

The recent Human Rights Watch (HRW) report clearly suggests that the International Crimes Tribunal in Bangladesh is not adhering to the standards of the rule of law. Instead, it is being weaponized to oppress the political opposition. The most significant point I found in the report is the apparent shift from the figure of 1,400 casualties cited in the UN report to more than 800. The relevant excerpt from the @hrw report states: “The tribunal is hearing cases related to the security forces’ crackdown on student-led protests in July and August 2024, resulting in over 800 deaths…” With this wording, the report no longer uses the figure of 1,400 casualties that was mentioned in the #UN report. Previously, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina also wrote to the UN requesting the evidence supporting its claim of 1,400 casualties in its report. According to her, the UN has not responded to that request. It is also worth noting that this is not the first time the UN has revised or corrected casualty estimates. For example, in the case of Gaza, the UN later revised its estimated death toll downward from an earlier estimate. Here is the link: cfr.org/articles/un-halves-i… foxnews.com/world/un-revises… Now, the important point is this: if the figure is not 1,400, isn’t the number 834 alone sufficient to ensure accountability for those deaths? I believe the answer is YES. However, it is important to first acknowledge the actual number rather than create a false narrative based on a fictitious figure simply because the UN suggested it. Now, let’s talk about the 834 casualties. I believe it is important to ensure accountability for the deaths of those people. But is that what is happening? I don’t believe so. Instead, the International Crimes Tribunal in Bangladesh (ICT-BD) is being used as a tool for political oppression, a concern that has now also been acknowledged by Human Rights Watch (HRW). Link of the HRW report: hrw.org/news/2026/07/28/bang… Of the 834 individuals whose identities have reportedly been established, a genuinely impartial investigation into each case could have helped determine the actual circumstances and causes of death. This raises an important question: why has there not been an independent investigation into even a single case over the past two years? Some may wonder whether a thorough and transparent inquiry would reveal facts that challenge prevailing narratives about the events of July. If the true causes of these deaths were established through credible investigations, it could provide a clearer understanding of what actually occurred and allow competing claims to be evaluated against evidence rather than speculation and the established narrative. The absence of such investigations fuels concerns that important facts remain undisclosed. A proper examination of the evidence could either validate or undermine the claims made by those who continue to invoke the legacy of “July,” and that only an independent, fact-based process can resolve these questions and bring greater clarity to the public. That’s why I sometimes wonder whether the truth really matters, or whether everything is ultimately about controlling the narrative, regardless of how much it is based on falsehoods. -Mohammad Ali Arafat

समाजातील अन्याय, त्या अन्यायाविरुद्ध उभे राहणारे नायक आणि संघर्ष करणारी पात्रे यांचे प्रभावी चित्रण त्यांनी आपल्या साहित्यामधून केले. विशेषतः कामगारांच्या जीवनातील संघर्ष त्यांनी अत्यंत प्रभावीपणे मांडल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. मानवी मनातील संवेदना अत्यंत प्रभावी आणि हळुवारपणे व्यक्त करण्याची विलक्षण क्षमता साहित्यरत्न, लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे यांच्या लेखणीत होती. साहित्याच्या प्रत्येक क्षेत्रात अण्णाभाऊ यांनी आपला ठसा उमटविला. जे भोगायला मिळाले त्याला आपल्या शब्दांची ढाल देत साहित्याच्या माध्यमातून भारताच्या स्वातंत्र्यलढ्यात तसेच संयुक्त महाराष्ट्र चळवळीत तरुणांना प्रेरणा दिली, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. संयुक्त महाराष्ट्राच्या लढ्यात साहित्यरत्न, लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे यांची गीते अन्यायाविरुद्ध जनतेचा आवाज बनली. केवळ साहित्य नव्हे तर त्या साहित्यातून अंगार फुलवणारे साहित्यरत्न, लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे होते. अण्णाभाऊ यांनी आपल्या साहित्यातून मराठी भाषेची कीर्ती सातासमुद्रापार पोहोचविली. जगातील अनेक प्रगत देशांच्या भाषांमध्ये त्यांच्या साहित्याचे अनुवाद झाले आहेत. यावरून त्यांच्या साहित्याची धार आणि प्रभाव किती व्यापक होता हे अधोरेखित होते. साहित्यरत्न, लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे यांच्या नावाने नाट्यगृह उभारले जाणे म्हणजे त्यांच्या कार्याला पुढे नेण्यासाठी केलेली एक समर्पित कृती असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. या नाट्यगृहाच्या माध्यमातून साहित्यरत्न, लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे यांचे विचार अनंत काळापर्यंत समाजापर्यंत पोहोचविण्याचे काम व्हावे. अण्णाभाऊ हे वंचित, शोषित आणि सर्वसामान्य समाजाचा आवाज होते. त्यामुळे हे नाट्यगृह समाजातील शेवटच्या घटकासाठीही सहज उपलब्ध होईल, अशा पद्धतीने त्याचे नियोजन करावे. मोदी जी के किसान कल्याण के संकल्प से शुरू हुई 'PM-KISAN योजना' किसानों के जीवन में सकारात्मक परिवर्तन ला रही है। अब तक करोड़ों किसानों को इसके तहत ₹4.47 लाख करोड़ से अधिक की राशि दी जा चुकी है। आज केंद्रीय कैबिनेट ने ₹3.15 लाख करोड़ की लागत से इस कल्याणकारी योजना को वर्ष 2030–31 तक बढ़ाने की स्वीकृति दी। यह योजना किसानों को समय पर बीज, खाद खरीदने, उत्पादन बढ़ाने और उनकी आय में वृद्धि कराने में अहम सिद्ध हो रही है।

किसानों की समृद्धि को राष्ट्र की प्रगति का आधार मानते हुए, प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी के नेतृत्व में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि (PM-KISAN) योजना को 2026-27 से 2030-31 तक जारी रखने का महत्वपूर्ण निर्णय लिया है, जिसके लिए ₹3.15 लाख करोड़ रुपये की मंजूरी दी गई है। यह ऐतिहासिक निर्णय देश के करोड़ों किसान भाइयों और बहनों को समय पर आर्थिक सहायता प्रदान करने, कृषि निवेश को बढ़ावा देने और ग्रामीण अर्थव्यवस्था को और मजबूत करने की दिशा में एक बड़ा कदम है। PM-KISAN योजना पारदर्शी DBT व्यवस्था के माध्यम से किसानों को सीधे लाभ पहुंचाकर आत्मनिर्भरता और सशक्तिकरण का माध्यम बनी है। यह सहायता किसानों को बीज, उर्वरक, सिंचाई और अन्य कृषि आवश्यकताओं में निवेश करने में मदद कर रही है। किसान कल्याण के प्रति प्रधानमंत्री मोदी जी की प्रतिबद्धता और इस दूरदर्शी निर्णय के लिए हार्दिक आभार। यह निर्णय विकसित भारत के निर्माण में हमारे अन्नदाताओं की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका को और सशक्त करेगा।

At the National Conference on Goan Architecture & Sustainability: Heritage, Climate Resilience & the Goa Model of Sustainable Building, Prof. (Dr.) M. Srinivas, Member (Health), NITI Aayog, highlighted that architecture is a powerful determinant of health. He emphasized that climate-responsive design, natural light, and cross-ventilation are not merely architectural features, but evidence-based interventions that improve patient outcomes, reduce healthcare-associated infections, and strengthen health system resilience. Drawing on the example of Kangaroo Mother Care, where a mother's warmth and skin-to-skin contact serve as a natural therapeutic intervention to improve newborn survival and recovery, along with the successful transformation of hostels into patient wards at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Hyderabad, and TB care facilities designed with optimal ventilation, he underscored how thoughtful design that harnesses natural elements can accelerate healing while promoting sustainability. As India advances towards #ViksitBharat2047, integrating health into sustainable architecture will be key to building healthier, greener, and more resilient communities. #OneHealth #ClimateResilience #SustainableArchitecture @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

With a strong focus on nurturing sporting talent, empowering youth, and strengthening India's position on the global sports stage, the Union Cabinet, chaired by PM Shri @narendramodi, has approved the revamped Khelo India Scheme and enhanced assistance to National Sports Federations with a historic outlay of ₹36,441 crore for the period 2026–27 to 2030–31. This decision will create a comprehensive sports ecosystem that provides a clear pathway for talented athletes, from grassroots discovery and school-level participation to world-class training and international competitions. The expanded scheme will strengthen sports infrastructure, promote scientific coaching, support women athletes and para-athletes, encourage indigenous sports, enhance fitness initiatives and ensure that no talent remains undiscovered due to lack of opportunity. By investing in young athletes, coaches, technology and high-performance systems, this initiative will lay the foundation for a new era of sporting excellence and inspire millions of young Indians to pursue their dreams. This decision reflects the Government's commitment to youth empowerment, nation-building and the vision of Viksit Bharat. Sincere thanks to PM Modi ji for his constant support in developing a more vibrant sports culture in India.

In a significant step towards strengthening India's energy security and unlocking our vast offshore potential, the Union Cabinet, chaired by PM Shri @narendramodi, has approved ‘Samudra Manthan’ – the National Offshore Exploration Scheme with an outlay of ₹84,084 crore up to FY 2030–31. This landmark initiative will accelerate offshore exploration and production, promote advanced technologies, create employment opportunities, strengthen indigenous manufacturing under Make in India and Aatmanirbhar Bharat and enhance India's self-reliance in the oil and gas sector. By developing a modern offshore exploration ecosystem with world-class infrastructure, innovation, and scientific capabilities, Samudra Manthan will make a significant contribution towards India's long-term energy security and the vision of Viksit Bharat. I thank PM Modi for this decision.

In yet another decisive step towards realizing the vision of Viksit Bharat and strengthening India's global leadership in clean energy, the Union Cabinet, chaired by PM Shri @narendramodi, has approved the Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana (PM-SSY). This landmark initiative will unlock the immense potential of reservoirs and inland water bodies through 5,000 MW of floating solar capacity integrated with energy storage. It will help in enhancing energy security, reducing pressure on scarce land resources, generating thousands of employment opportunities, and reducing nearly 10 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually. The scheme reflects the Government's unwavering commitment to sustainable development, technological innovation, climate responsibility and inclusive economic growth, while accelerating India's transition towards a greener, more self-reliant future. Heartfelt gratitude to PM Modi ji for this decision.

اسلام آباد، 31 جولائی 2026. وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف سے عالمی بینک کی کنٹری ڈائریکٹر بولورما امگآبزر (Ms Bolormaa Amgaabazar) کی قیادت میں وفد کی آج اسلام آباد میں ملاقات ہوئی. وفد کا خیرمقدم کرتے ہوئے وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے عالمی بینک کے ساتھ پاکستان کی دیرینہ شراکت داری کو سراہا اور پاکستان کی سماجی و معاشی ترقی میں ادارے کے کردار کی تعریف کی۔ وزیراعظم نے عالمی بینک کی پاکستان کے ترقیاتی سفر میں مسلسل معاونت پر شکریہ ادا کیا۔ وزیراعظم نے کہا کہ حکومت معیشت کو مستحکم اور پائیدار ترقی کی راہ پر گامزن کرنے کے لیے اصلاحات کے ایجنڈے پر بھرپور عملدرآمد جاری رکھے ہوئے ہے۔ پاکستان کا آئینی وفاقی ڈھانچہ، صوبائی خودمختاری اور وفاق اور صوبوں کے درمیان باہمی تعاون و مشاورت ملک کی ترقی اور استحکام کے لیے بنیادی اہمیت رکھتے ہیں. ورلڈ بینک کی کنٹری ڈائریکٹر نے "پاکستان میں مالیاتی وفاقیت کو مضبوط بنانے" (Strengthening Fiscal Federalism in Pakistan) رپورٹ پیش کی اور رپورٹ کے مندرجات پر بریفننگ دی۔ ورلڈ بینک کے وفد نے اپنی رپورٹ کے اہم نکات پیش کرتے ہوئے پاکستان میں اٹھارہویں آئینی ترمیم اور ساتویں قومی مالیاتی کمیشن (این ایف سی) ایوارڈ کے بعد مالیاتی وفاقیت کے ارتقاء، محصولات، اخراجات، وفاقی و صوبائی مالیاتی تعلقات، ادارہ جاتی ہم آہنگی اور عوامی وسائل کے استعمال سے متعلق اپنے تجزیے اور مشاہدات سے آگاہ کیا۔ وفد نے اپنی رپورٹ میں مختلف پالیسی سفارشات بھی پیش کیں جن کا مقصد، مالیاتی نظم و ضبط، وسائل کے مؤثر استعمال، خدمات کی فراہمی میں بہتری اور وفاقی و صوبائی اداروں کے درمیان مؤثر تعاون کو فروغ دینا ہے۔ وزیراعظم نے کہا کہ عالمی بینک کی جانب سے پیش کیا گیا تجزیہ اور بین الاقوامی تجربات کی روشنی میں تقابلی جائزہ لائق تحسین ہے، ایسے مطالعات پالیسی سازی کے عمل میں مفید رہنمائی فراہم کرنے میں کلیدی اہمیت کے حامل ہیں۔ وزیراعظم نے رپورٹ کا تفصیلی جائزہ لینے کے لیے اعلیٰ سطحی کمیٹی قائم کرنے کی ہدایت دی۔ یہ کمیٹی عالم بینک کی رپورٹ میں پیش کی گئی سفارشات کا متعلقہ فریقین بشمول صوبوں سے مشاورت اور پاکستان کے آئینی و وفاقی ڈھانچے کو مدنظر رکھتے ہوئے جائزہ لے گی، تاکہ عوامی مفاد میں قابلِ عمل تجاویز پر غور کیا جا سکے۔ ملاقات میں نائب وزیراعظم و وزیر خارجہ محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزراء احد خان چیمہ اور احسن اقبال، مشیر وزیر اعظم ڈاکٹر سید توقیر شاہ، وزیر مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی اور اعلیٰ سرکاری حکام بھی موجود تھے۔. ইসলামে জুমার দিনের গুরুত্ব অপরিসীম। সপ্তাহের সাত দিনের মধ্যে জুমার দিনকে ‘সায়্যিদুল আইয়াম’ বা দিনসমূহের অধিপতি বলা হয়েছে। এই দিনের অসংখ্য ফজিলতের মধ্যে অন্যতম হলো ‘দোয়া কবুলের বিশেষ মুহূর্ত’। হাদিস শরিফের বর্ণনা অনুযায়ী, জুমার দিনে এমন একটি সময় আছে, যখন বান্দার কোনো দোয়াই মহান আল্লাহ ফিরিয়ে দেন না। জুমার দিনের এই বিশেষ সময় সম্পর্কে আল্লাহর রসুল (স.) সুসংবাদ দিয়েছেন। আবু হুরায়রা (রা.) থেকে বর্ণিত, তিনি বলেন, রসুলুল্লাহ (স.) জুমার দিনের আলোচনা করতে গিয়ে বলেন- ‘এই দিনে এমন একটি সময় আছে, যদি কোনো মুসলিম বান্দা সেই সময়টি পায় এবং নামাজরত অবস্থায় আল্লাহর কাছে কিছু প্রার্থনা করে, তবে আল্লাহ তাকে অবশ্যই তা দান করেন।’ এরপর তিনি হাত দিয়ে ইশারা করে বুঝিয়ে দিলেন যে, সেই মুহূর্তটি অত্যন্ত সংক্ষিপ্ত। (সহিহ বুখারি: ৯৩৫) দোয়া কবুলের সেই সময়টি কখন? দোয়া কবুলের এই বিশেষ সময়টি ঠিক কখন- তা নিয়ে হাদিস বিশারদ ও সলফে সালেহিনদের মাঝে একাধিক মত থাকলেও দুটি সময়কে সবচেয়ে বেশি প্রাধান্য দেওয়া হয়েছে-- প্রথম মত: খুতবা শুরু থেকে নামাজ শেষ হওয়া পর্যন্ত আবু বুরদা (রহ.) বলেন, আব্দুল্লাহ ইবনে ওমর (রা.) আমাকে জিজ্ঞেস করলেন, জুমার দিনের দোয়া কবুলের সময় সম্পর্কে আপনি আপনার পিতা আবু মুসা আশআরি (রা.)-এর কাছ থেকে কোনো হাদিস শুনেছেন? আমি বললাম, হ্যাঁ, শুনেছি। রসুলুল্লাহ (স.) বলেছেন, ‘সে সময়টি হলো- ইমাম (খুতবার জন্য মিম্বরে) বসার পর থেকে জুমার নামাজ শেষ হওয়া পর্যন্ত।’ (সুনানে আবু দাউদ: ১০৪৯) দ্বিতীয় মত: আছরের পর থেকে সূর্যাস্ত পর্যন্ত অধিকাংশ গবেষক আলেমের মতে, জুমার দিনের সেই কাঙ্ক্ষিত সময়টি হলো আছরের নামাজের পর থেকে সূর্যাস্ত পর্যন্ত। জাবির ইবনে আব্দুল্লাহ (রা.) থেকে বর্ণিত, রসুলুল্লাহ (স.) বলেছেন- ‘জুমার দিনের বারো ঘন্টার মধ্যে একটি বিশেষ মুহূর্ত আছে, তখন কোনো মুসলিম আল্লাহর নিকট যা-ই দোয়া করে আল্লাহ তা কবুল করেন। তোমরা এই মুহূর্তটিকে আছরের শেষে অনুসন্ধান কর।’ (সুনানে আবু দাউদ: ১০৪৮) বিস্তারিত কমেন্টে… #Jumuah #Islam #Dua #somoytv

Pakistan’s armed forces have countered protests in the region, unleashing a brutal crackdown. #CutTheClutter looks at the latest developments in India’s neighbourhood, why they are significant, explains the politics of PoK, & why Pakistan’s ‘Azad Kashmir’ pitch is a pretence. 2. This is the election for the local assembly or Parliament. It is being held in 3 phases: July 27 (Mirpur), Aug 3 (Muzaffarabad) & Aug 10 (Poonch). According to reports, at least 37 people have been killed. Since June, the broader unrest has claimed around 90 lives. Pakistan has described the protesters as anti-national & pro-India. Khawaja Asif alleged they were Indian agents & claimed the involvement of Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan. 3. Why the protests & violence? To understand the grievances, we first need a quick look at the PoK assembly's composition. There are 53 members, but 20 are directly or indirectly controlled by the govt through nominations & seat allocations. That's why the anger among the people, because they feel they have no autonomy, the election is a sham & their vote has no value. 4. Here’s the breakup: · Of the 53 members, 45 are elected. 8 are nominated — including women, a technocrat, a cleric & a non-resident Kashmiri · Among the 45, only 33 are directly elected · 12 seats are reserved for people designated as Kashmiri refugees living elsewhere in Pakistan, who vote from outside the territory. 5. Pakistan has always claimed Azad Kashmir is a separate entity, an autonomous territory. The pretence is such that it does not hold elections in these territories for its National Assembly, maintaining that the region’s future remains undecided. Yet it has a federal ministry for Kashmir & Gilgit-Baltistan Affairs & a Kashmir Council headed by Pakistan’s PM. 6. Even if a plebiscite is held based on UN resolutions, there will be only 2 choices — India or Pakistan. There is no third option of an independent state. Also, there’s a clause in Pakistan’s 1974 Constitution for the territory that bars political activity against the ideology of the state’s accession to Pakistan. 7. #CutTheClutter with me: Munir's crackdown during PoK polls: Region's politics, complexities & Pakistan's 'Kashmir' pretence ￼ youtube.com/watch?v=K7iijUj2…

اسلام آباد: 31 جولائی 2026ء. وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت آج آئل اینڈ گیس ریگولیٹری اتھارٹی (اوگرا) کی اصلاحات اور ادارہ جاتی استعداد میں بہتری کے حوالے سے ایک اعلیٰ سطحی اجلاس منعقد ہوا. گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ حکومت کے اصلاحاتی ایجنڈے کا تمام اداروں میں یکساں طور پر نفاذ یقینی بنایا جائے. ایف بی آر کے جدید ٹریکنگ نظام کو ماڈل بنا کر ملک میں ایندھن کی آمدورفت کی کڑی نگرانی کا نظام وضع کیا جائے. جدید ٹیکنالوجی و سافٹ وئیر کے استعمال کے اطلاق سے بندرگاہوں و ریفائینریوں سے پٹرول پمپس تک سپلائی چین کی ڈیجیٹل نگرانی کی جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ اوگرا کے استعداد اضافے کیلئے نجی شعبے سے اچھی شہرت کے ماہرین تعینات کیے جائیں. اوگرا کی نتظیم نو کرکے ہر شعبے اور منصب کیلئے ماہرین کی میرٹ پر شفاف طریقہ کار سے تعیناتی کی جائے. اوگرا کی اصلاحات و تنظیمِ نو کیلئے حکومت ہر قسم کے پیشہ ورانہ مہارت فراہم کرے گی. حکومت عوام کی ایک ایک پائی کا تحفظ کرے گی، کسی کو عوام کے استحصال اور سسٹم میں مداخلت کی اجازت نہیں دیں گے. تمام ریگولیٹری اداروں کا اپنے متعلقہ وزارتوں سے باضابطہ رابطہ قائم کرنے کیلئے ضروری اقدامات لئے جائیں. منظور شدہ پالیسی کے تحت ملک میں قائم آئل ریفائنریوں کی اپگریڈ یشن پر کام تیز کیا جائے. اجلاس میں چیئرمین اوگرا نے ادارے کی موجودہ کارکردگی، درپیش چیلنجز اور جامع اصلاحاتی پروگرام پر تفصیلی بریفنگ دی۔ اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ اوگرا نے تیل کی سپلائی-چین کو بندرگاہ سے پٹرول پمپ تک ڈیجیٹل نظام کے ذریعے مانیٹر کرنے کے لیے اہم پیش رفت کی ہے۔ قومی مانیٹرنگ ڈیش بورڈ، ٹینکر ٹریک اینڈ ٹریس سسٹم، ڈپو - ٹینک ٹیلی میٹری، راہگزر موبائل ایپ، پٹرول پمپس پر ڈیجیٹل سیلز انٹری سسٹم اور مرکزی مانیٹرنگ سیل جیسے متعدد ڈیجیٹل نظام فعال کیے جا چکے ہیں، جن کے ذریعے پٹرولیم مصنوعات کی نقل و حرکت، ذخائر اور فروخت کی مؤثر نگرانی ممکن بنائی جا رہی ہے۔ وزیراعظم کو آگاہ کیا گیا کہ جولائی 2026 کے دوران ڈیٹا پر مبنی خصوصی مہم کے نتیجے میں ذخیرہ اندوزی، سپلائی میں غیر ضروری رکاوٹوں اور دیگر خلاف ورزیوں کے متعدد واقعات کی نشاندہی کی گئی، جن پر شوکاز نوٹسز، وضاحت طلبی اور دیگر قانونی کارروائیاں عمل میں لائی گئیں۔ اجلاس میں اوگرا کے جامع اصلاحاتی پروگرام پر بھی بریفنگ دی گئی، جس میں ادارے کی ڈیجیٹلائزیشن، انفورسمنٹ نظام کی ازسرِنو تشکیل، کمپلائنس ونگ کے قیام، لائسنسنگ نظام میں اصلاحات، قانونی امور کے مؤثر انتظام، مالی وسائل کی مضبوطی اور ادارہ جاتی ڈھانچے کی تنظیمِ نو شامل ہے۔ وزیراعظم نے اوگرا کی جانب سے پیش کیے گئے اصلاحاتی پروگرام کو سراہتے ہوئے ہدایت کی کہ تیل و گیس کے شعبے میں مکمل شفافیت، مؤثر نگرانی، ذخیرہ اندوزی اور ناجائز منافع خوری کے خاتمے کے لیے جدید ڈیجیٹل نظام کو جلد از جلد مکمل طور پر فعال بنایا جائے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ عوام کو ایندھن کی بلاتعطل فراہمی اور منصفانہ قیمتوں کی یقینی فراہمی حکومت کی اولین ترجیح ہے اور اس مقصد کے لیے کسی قسم کی غفلت یا بدعنوانی برداشت نہیں کی جائے گی۔ وزیراعظم نے متعلقہ وزارتوں اور اداروں کو ہدایت کی کہ اوگرا کی اصلاحات اور ادارہ جاتی استعداد میں اضافے کے لیے درکار قانونی، انتظامی اور پالیسی اقدامات پر ترجیحی بنیادوں پر پیش رفت یقینی بنائی جائے تاکہ ریگولیٹری نظام کو مزید مؤثر، شفاف اور جدید تقاضوں سے ہم آہنگ بنایا جا سکے۔ اجلاس میں نائب وزیرِ اعظم و وزیرِ خارجہ سینیٹر محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزراء اعظم نذیر تارڑ، ڈاکٹر مصدق ملک، احد خان چیمہ، عطاء اللہ تارڑ، شزہ فاطمہ خواجہ، علی پرویز ملک، معاون خصوصی طارق باجوہ اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. বাংলাদেশের ক্ষমতাচ্যুত প্রধানমন্ত্রী শেখ হাসিনাকে ভারতের মাটি থেকে কোনো রাজনৈতিক কর্মকাণ্ড পরিচালনা করার সুযোগ দেওয়া হচ্ছে না বলে দেশটির সংসদীয় কমিটিকে জানিয়েছে ভারত সরকার। শেখ হাসিনার চলতি বছরের শেষ নাগাদ দেশে ফেরার সাম্প্রতিক ঘোষণার প্রেক্ষাপটে এই অবস্থান জানিয়েছে ভারত সরকার। ভারতীয় সংবাদমাধ্যম ইন্ডিয়ান এক্সপ্রেসের প্রতিবেদন থেকে এ তথ্য জানা গেছে। ভারতের পররাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয় পররাষ্ট্রবিষয়ক ওই সংসদীয় কমিটিকে জানিয়েছে, ‘হাসিনার বিরুদ্ধে ঢাকার পাঠানো প্রত্যর্পণ অনুরোধটি প্রাসঙ্গিক আইন ও নির্ধারিত প্রক্রিয়া মেনে ভারত সরকারের সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষ পর্যালোচনা করে দেখছে।’ বিরোধী দল কংগ্রেসের এমপি শশী থারুরের নেতৃত্বাধীন কমিটি উল্লেখ করেছে, শেখ হাসিনার ভারতে অবস্থান এবং এ বিষয়ে ভারতের দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি নির্ধারিত হয়েছে ‘তার (ভারত রাষ্ট্রের) সভ্যতাগত সংস্কৃতি এবং চরম বিপদ বা অস্তিত্বের ঝুঁকিতে থাকা ব্যক্তিদের আশ্রয় দেওয়ার মানবিক ঐতিহ্য’ দ্বারা। কমিটি পর্যবেক্ষণে আরও বলেছে, এই ধরনের মানবিক বিবেচনা দেখানোর পাশাপাশি ভারত কঠোরভাবে এই নীতি মেনে চলেছে যে—তার ভূখণ্ড ব্যবহার করে অন্য কোনো দেশের বিরুদ্ধে কোনো রাজনৈতিক কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা যাবে না। ‘ভারত-বাংলাদেশ সম্পর্কের ভবিষ্যৎ’-বিষয়ক তাদের সাম্প্রতিক প্রতিবেদনে কমিটি সুপারিশ করেছে, ভারত সরকারের উচিত তার নীতিগত ও মানবিক দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি বজায় রাখা...এবং একই সঙ্গে এমন পরিস্থিতি যেন পূর্ণ সংবেদনশীলতার সঙ্গে সামলানো হয় তা নিশ্চিত করা। #InternationalNews #news #somoytv

DEL CRUCE DEL ATLÁNTICO AL RÍO DE LA PLATA: LA HISTORIA DE LAS MUJERES AFRICANAS ESCLAVIZADAS Y SU LUCHA POR LA LIBERTAD El 31 de julio de 1962, en Dar es-Salam, entonces capital de Tanganica (actual Tanzania), se realizó la Primera Conferencia de las Mujeres Africanas. El encuentro reunió a delegadas de catorce países independientes y representantes de ocho movimientos de liberación nacional. De aquella cumbre nació la Organización Panafricana de Mujeres (PAWO) y también se instituyó la conmemoración que cada 31 de julio recuerda la lucha de las mujeres africanas por sus derechos políticos, sociales y económicos. La historia de las mujeres africanas, sin embargo, también está marcada por uno de los mayores crímenes de la historia: la trata transatlántica de personas africanas esclavizadas. Entre los siglos XVI y XIX, millones fueron capturadas, separadas de sus familias y comunidades, trasladadas por la fuerza hacia América y sometidas a un régimen de esclavitud. Ambassador of the Republic of Azerbaijan to Pakistan, H.E. Mr. Khazar Farhadov, paid a farewell call on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Islamabad, 31 July 2026.

Islamabad: 31 July 2026. Ambassador of the Republic of Azerbaijan to Pakistan, H.E. Mr. Khazar Farhadov, paid a farewell call on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister’s House. Deputy Prime Minister & Foreign Minister Sen. Mohammad Ishaq Dar and Foreign Secretary Amb. Amna Baloch were also present. During the meeting, the Prime Minister warmly acknowledged Ambassador Farhadov's dedicated efforts to strengthen the deep-rooted, brotherly relations between Pakistan and Azerbaijan during his tenure. He commended the Ambassador's contributions in expanding bilateral cooperation across political, trade, economic, defence, culture and people-to-people domains, including the launch of direct flights between the two countries. While conveying his warm regards to President Ilham Aliyev, the Prime Minister fondly recalled his numerous visits to Azerbaijan over the past two and a half years, as well as the visit of President Aliyev to Pakistan in July 2024. He reaffirmed Pakistan's unwavering commitment to further strengthening these brotherly ties with Azerbaijan and expressed confidence that the strong foundation laid during Ambassador Farhadov's tenure would continue to guide the trajectory of bilateral ties in the years ahead. The Prime Minister wished Ambassador Farhadov continued success in his future assignments. Ambassador Farhadov thanked the Prime Minister for the warmth, hospitality, and support extended to him by the Government and people of Pakistan throughout his diplomatic assignment, describing his tenure in Pakistan as a cherished chapter of his diplomatic career. He reaffirmed Azerbaijan's continued commitment to deepening its strategic partnership with Pakistan. He also presented the Prime Minister with a book based on his family’s experiences of living in Pakistan. Video

নেপালের দক্ষিণাঞ্চলে হিন্দু ও মুসলিমদের মধ্যে দফায় দফায় সংঘর্ষে তিন ব্যক্তি নিহত হয়েছেন। রক্তাক্ত এ সংঘাতের জেরে দেশবাসীকে শান্ত থাকার জোর আহ্বান জানিয়েছেন দেশটির নতুন প্রধানমন্ত্রী বালেন্দ্র শাহ। গত মার্চ মাসে কার্যভার গ্রহণের পর থেকে জনসমক্ষে খুব একটা আসেননি তিনি। তবে দীর্ঘদিনের সেই নীরবতা ভেঙে বৃহস্পতিবার (৩০ জুলাই) জাতির উদ্দেশে প্রথম ভাষণ দেন বালেন্দ্র শাহ। দেশের নাগরিকদের দায়িত্বশীল আচরণ করার অনুরোধ জানিয়ে দেশটির প্রধানমন্ত্রী বলেন, ‘আসুন, সবাই মিলে অশান্তির মেঘ দূর করি।’ সরকারি কর্মকর্তাদের দেওয়া তথ্য অনুযায়ী, গত রোববার ভারত সীমান্তবর্তী সুনসারি জেলার একটি গ্রামে সহিংসতার সূত্রপাত। সেখানে হিন্দুদের একটি ধর্মীয় শোভাযাত্রায় উচ্চ শব্দে গান বাজানো এবং ধর্মীয় পতাকা টাঙানোকে কেন্দ্র করে তাদের সঙ্গে মুসলিমদের তুমুল বাগ্‌বিতণ্ডা হয়। একপর্যায়ে তা রূপ নেয় রক্তক্ষয়ী সংঘর্ষে। এমন পরিস্থিতি নিয়ন্ত্রণে পুলিশ গুলি চালালে দুজন নিহত হন বলে জানিয়েছেন পুলিশের মুখপাত্র আবি নারায়ণ কাফ্লে। এরপর পার্শ্ববর্তী সিরাহা জেলায় কারফিউ ভেঙে বিক্ষোভ করার সময় গতকাল আরও এক ব্যক্তির মৃত্যু ঘটে। পরিস্থিতির আরও অবনতি হওয়া ঠেকাতে স্থানীয় প্রশাসন সুনসারি ও এর আশপাশের জেলাগুলোতে কঠোর কারফিউ জারি করেছে। উদ্ভূত পরিস্থিতিতে প্রধানমন্ত্রী বালেন্দ্র শাহ বলেন, ‘আমি সরকারের পক্ষ থেকে সব নাগরিক, সুশীল সমাজ, ধর্মীয় সম্প্রদায়, নেতা, রাজনৈতিক দল ও দায়িত্বশীল গণমাধ্যমের প্রতি বিনীত অনুরোধ জানাচ্ছি। আপনারা সবাই ধৈর্য ও সংযম বজায় রাখুন। দেশে শান্তি, সম্প্রীতি, ভ্রাতৃত্ব এবং জাতীয় ঐক্য রক্ষা করাই এখন আমাদের মূল লক্ষ্য।’ #somoytv #nepal #balendrashah #Curfew

Artificial intelligence is being sold as the biggest economic shock in a generation, a productivity revolution that will decide which countries grow rich and which fall behind. The machinery of it has already become a contest of power: chips have become chokepoints, compute is rationed by export controls, and the routine coding and back-office work that lifted millions across the developing world is squarely in the crosshairs. In this episode of Turbulence, Anupam Manur (@anupammanur) is joined by two guides to the two halves of the story. Pranay Kotasthane (@pranaykotas) maps the geopolitics of AI, including the chips, the compute, and the contest for power. Economist Ashish Kulkarni brings in the economics and answers whether the productivity boom is real or overhyped, and who actually captures the gains. Together, they work through the question that matters most for India: does AI offer the developing world a shortcut up the ladder, or kick it away? Also, whether export controls actually work, and whether India should build its own "sovereign AI" or simply buy it in. 𝗚𝗶𝗿𝗹𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁-𝗲𝗻𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗲𝗻 𝗶𝗻 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮 According to AISHE 2023–24: •The national Gender Parity Index (GPI) reached a record 1.08, up from the previous high of 1.06 in 2019–20. •The Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) for women increased to 31.2%, compared with 28.9% for men. •Women's enrolment now exceeds men's in all but three states. The pandemic briefly pulled the GPI down to 1.01, but women's enrolment continued to rise throughout. Men's enrolment simply grew faster for two years before women widened their lead again, taking the index to its highest level in 2023–24. The state-level picture is equally encouraging. Even among the seven states where the GPI declined, six recorded higher enrolment for women—the index fell only because men's enrolment increased faster. Manipur was the only exception, with enrolment declining for both women and men. The Gender Parity Index is most useful when read alongside enrolment rates. It shows that higher education is expanding across India, with women benefiting the most, while also highlighting the states where women's access still lags or where changes in parity require closer interpretation, such as Bihar. The real challenge now lies beyond the classroom. India has made remarkable progress in educating women. The next policy imperative is ensuring these educational gains translate into higher female labour force participation, better-quality jobs, and stronger representation in the workforce. #GenderParity #WomenInEducation #FemaleLabourForceParticipation #EducationToEmployment #India #GenderData #WomenEmpowerment

The UK Parliament's Defence Committee has said that the leak of the personal data of around 25,000 Afghan applicants for resettlement in Britain was the result of a "foreseeable systemic failure." For the longest time Azure AD/Entra ID didn't support nesting. In fact M365 Groups still don't support nesting. There were many enteprise orgs that refused to deploy Entra ID without nesting so finally Microsoft relented and added nesting to just security groups so they could be synced from on-prem and bring the structures over. However from a security perspective Entra ID still does not support nested groups in a number of scenarios the key one being to grant permissions to apps in Entra. If you assign a group with nested groups to an app, just users that are directly assigned to the group are granted access. Users inside nested groups are ignored. Adding support for nested groups is one of the #1 requests from many orgs. Hopefully they never allow it.

Addressed the nation from State House Nairobi and invited all Kenyans to begin the most consequential national conversation since the promulgation of our Constitution in 2010 - a conversation to shape the country's next long-term development plan beyond Vision 2030. This is not a Government project. It is not a political agenda; it is a national undertaking that belongs to every Kenyan. The question before us is simple but profound: What kind of Kenya do we want to leave to future generations? Over the past six decades, nations that were once at the same level of development with Kenya have transformed into global economic powerhouses. South Korea, China and Singapore made bold choices, planned for the long-term and invested in their people. We, too, must have the courage to ask why we have not fulfilled our full potential and, more importantly, what we must do differently. Our Constitution calls on us to do more than govern. It calls on us to expand opportunity, uphold human dignity, create wealth and improve the lives of every citizen. Healthcare, quality education, affordable housing and food security must become measurable realities for every Kenyan. Consequently, we will on 12th August, 2026, launch a nationwide public consultation that will bring together citizens from every walk of life - young people, professionals, businesses, faith leaders, academia, workers and civil society - to build a shared vision for our nation's future. Together, we will define the next chapter of Kenya's story and build an industrialised, globally competitive and prosperous nation for generations to come.

Today, Zelenskyy, Starmer, Macron, and Merz meet in London. The format itself is worth welcoming, even if the EU has once again been left on the sidelines. The real question is what mindset the E3 brings to the table. Zelenskyy set the tone with his open letter to Putin. While his European partners likely share its substance, they are unlikely to be ready to openly put their signatures beneath it. But they do see that Russia is not looking for middle ground. It is set on war. Seeking a balanced compromise with an aggressor committed to conquest is not diplomacy. It is self-deception. The predecessors of today’s leaders understood this well. Symbolically, eighty-five years ago, London hosted another gathering. In June 1941, representatives of fourteen Allied governments and liberation movements met there to unite against Nazism. The final London Declaration was not about ending a war. It was about uniting those willing to win it and shape the peace that followed. One can only hope today’s meeting is guided by the same logic. Europe’s prosperity depends on its security. Europe’s security depends on Ukraine. It is time to turn that truth into effective policy. And fast.

【買取業務に関するご報告とお詫び】 本日、当店にて買取をご利用いただいたお客様より、「提出したカードが足りない」とのご指摘をいただきました。お客様は7枚提出されたとお申し出いただきましたが、当店側では当時5枚しか確認できず、査定担当者も「そのカードは見ていない」と回答いたしました。 その後、受付担当が防犯カメラの映像確認を提案し、査定担当者が該当の映像を確認。映っていた場面を写真で撮影し、お客様に提示いたしましたが、その映像には5枚しか映っていないように見えました。 その時点で受付担当は「映像で5枚しか確認できないため、納得いただけない場合は警察を呼んでご確認いただいた方が良いのでは」とお伝えしました。この発言はお客様への不信を前提としたものではありませんでしたが、結果として高圧的に受け取られかねないものであり、深く反省しております。 一度はお客様より「納得した」とのお言葉をいただきましたが、その数時間後「やはり足りないので再確認してほしい」とのご連絡をいただきました。PSAの鑑定番号も添えていただき、改めてより広い範囲の映像を確認したところ、お客様が査定物を出す準備の段階において、確かに7枚のカードをお出しになっていたことが確認されました。 結果として、査定担当者が7枚中5枚のみを査定し、残りの2枚を誤って査定済み用のケースに収納していたことが原因であったことが判明しました。このミスにより、お客様に不信感とご迷惑をおかけしてしまったことを、深くお詫び申し上げます。 今回の件では以下のような点が、お客様の信頼を損なう結果につながってしまいました： ①防犯映像が5枚に見えたという理由のみで、お客様のご申告を否定してしまったこと （映像には角度や映り方による限界があり、確定的な判断材料とすべきではありませんでした） ②「警察を呼びますか」といった対応が、誠実さではなく威圧と受け取られるような表現になってしまったこと ③映像確認の範囲が不十分で、カード提出の準備段階を確認していなかったこと （結果として「十分に確認もしていないのに、否定された」と感じさせてしまった可能性があります） お客様の大切なお品物をお預かりする立場として、あるまじき対応だったと真摯に受け止めております。 今後は以下のような再発防止策を徹底し、同様のことが起こらぬよう努めてまいります。 ・査定時のカード枚数を受付・査定・返却の各段階で必ず記録・照合 ・映像確認は受付〜準備段階〜査定開始までを通して行うことを明文化 このたびは、お客様に多大なご不快とご心配をおかけし、誠に申し訳ございませんでした。 今後とも誠実な対応と改善に努めてまいります。

Celebrating a legacy in Earth Observation! 🎉 🚀 On July 23, 1972, Landsat 1 launched into orbit and changed the way we see our planet. As the first satellite in what would become the world’s longest-running Earth observing program, Landsat 1 began a legacy of continuous, trusted, and scientifically valuable land imaging that still supports research, decision making, and stewardship today. Within days of the launch, Landsat 1 acquired an image of an astounding 81,000-acre (327.8 square kilometers) fire burning in isolated, central Alaska. For the first time ever, scientists and resource management officials were able to see the full extent of damage from a fire in a single image while it was still burning. Landsat 1 marked the beginning of a long partnership between the USGS and NASA that continues today. NASA developed, launched, and operated the satellite, while the USGS helped shape its scientific objectives and established the EROS Data Center to archive and distribute its imagery. Together, the two agencies laid the foundation for the enduring Landsat program. From that first launch to the missions operating today, and those planned for the future, Landsat represents more than five decades of innovation, collaboration, and watching Earth change. Here’s to where it all began! 🛰️🌎 🔗 Learn more about the first Landsat mission: ow.ly/RF1I50Zrrte 📸1: Landsat 1 launched July 23, 1972, aboard a Delta 0900 rocket from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. Credit: NASA 📸2: Smoke from a large wildfire in a central Alaska can be seen on this false color image acquired by Landsat 1 on July 27, 1972. Credit: USGS #EarthObservation #LandsatLegacy

We have always supported open-weight models on Amazon Bedrock, starting back in 2023, and will continue to advocate for open ecosystems. No single model will define AI leadership. Customers need access to the most capable frontier models, alongside open-weight models they can adapt, optimize, and deploy for their own workloads. Open and closed models are complementary. Together, they expand access to AI, accelerate innovation, strengthen competition, and give organizations greater control over the technology they build. Successful leadership in AI will not be built around a single model or a single approach. It will be built on broad choice and the infrastructure to run those models securely, reliably, and at scale. While there are elements of the Open Weights and American AI Leadership letter that need further definition over time, we’re supportive of the macro direction and have signed it.

Addressed the nation from State House Nairobi and invited all Kenyans to begin the most consequential national conversation since the promulgation of our Constitution in 2010 - a conversation to shape the country's next long-term development plan beyond Vision 2030. This is not a Government project. It is not a political agenda; it is a national undertaking that belongs to every Kenyan. The question before us is simple but profound: What kind of Kenya do we want to leave to future generations? Over the past six decades, nations that were once at the same level of development with Kenya have transformed into global economic powerhouses. South Korea, China and Singapore made bold choices, planned for the long-term and invested in their people. We, too, must have the courage to ask why we have not fulfilled our full potential and, more importantly, what we must do differently. Our Constitution calls on us to do more than govern. It calls on us to expand opportunity, uphold human dignity, create wealth and improve the lives of every citizen. Healthcare, quality education, affordable housing and food security must become measurable realities for every Kenyan. Consequently, we will on 12th August, 2026, launch a nationwide public consultation that will bring together citizens from every walk of life - young people, professionals, businesses, faith leaders, academia, workers and civil society - to build a shared vision for our nation's future. Together, we will define the next chapter of Kenya's story and build an industrialised, globally competitive and prosperous nation for generations to come.

Uttar Pradesh's manufacturing push is increasingly focusing on the people behind its industries, not just infrastructure. While expressways, industrial parks and investment summits have attracted businesses, the state is strengthening its workforce through skill development, social security and support for its nearly 96 lakh MSMEs. Officials believe trained workers, artisans and technicians are key to sustaining industrial growth and improving competitiveness. Traditional industries are also being modernised under the One District One Product (ODOP) initiative, with artisans receiving support for branding, packaging, design and market access. Since 2018, more than 1.46 lakh artisans have been trained, over 20,000 entrepreneurs have benefited directly, and the programme has generated employment for more than 3.16 lakh people. Uttar Pradesh's exports have grown from ₹86,000 crore in 2017-18 to ₹1.84 lakh crore, with ODOP and handicraft products accounting for nearly half of the total exports. Alongside preserving traditional crafts, the state is expanding skill development through ITIs and PMKVY to prepare young workers for manufacturing jobs. By combining workforce training, MSME support and stronger market access, Uttar Pradesh aims to build a sustainable manufacturing ecosystem where long-term growth is driven not only by new factories but also by skilled workers, artisans and entrepreneurs. #UttarPradesh #MSMEs #ODOP #Manufacturing #SkillDevelopment

A migrant intercepted at sea therefore cannot be returned immediately without an individual administrative procedure. The ruling stems from an appeal brought by an Algerian national who was intercepted at sea while attempting to reach Sebta by swimming, then immediately returned to Morocco. The lower courts had already ruled in his favor. The Supreme Court now confirms this interpretation and unifies Spanish case law.
